metadata.quantum_depth_rationale: The task adds arithmetic and representation behavior for QuadraticHamiltonian coefficient blocks rather than new Hamiltonian semantics.

task.problem_statement: QuadraticHamiltonian stores tensor-like coefficient data, but it does not participate in the arithmetic and representation behavior shared by PolynomialTensor-backed containers. Users need compatible QuadraticHamiltonian objects to combine cleanly, scale by numeric factors from either side, compare by value, and display their coefficient data in a reproducible constructor-style form.
requirements: QuadraticHamiltonian instances must support equality and addition or subtraction with other compatible QuadraticHamiltonian instances.
QuadraticHamiltonian instances must support scalar multiplication from either side.
Arithmetic operations must combine the Hermitian part, antisymmetric part, and constant consistently with the requested operation.

The string representation must expose the Hermitian part, antisymmetric part, constant, and number of modes in a reproducible QuadraticHamiltonian constructor-style form, preserving the standard NumPy array representation including whitespace, line breaks, and alignment.

interface.Name: QuadraticHamiltonian
interface.Input: constructor: hermitian_part=None, antisymmetric_part=None, constant=0.0, num_modes=None, validate=True, rtol=None, atol=None
interface.Description: Quadratic fermionic Hamiltonian with coefficient data, value equality, addition, subtraction, scalar multiplication, and constructor-style repr behavior.

interface.Name: QuadraticHamiltonian.__eq__
interface.Description: Compares two quadratic Hamiltonians by coefficient data and constant.

interface.Name: QuadraticHamiltonian.__add__
interface.Description: Returns the sum of two compatible quadratic Hamiltonians.

interface.Name: QuadraticHamiltonian.__sub__
interface.Description: Returns the difference of two compatible quadratic Hamiltonians.

interface.Name: QuadraticHamiltonian.__mul__
interface.Description: Returns the quadratic Hamiltonian scaled by a numeric factor.

interface.Name: QuadraticHamiltonian.__rmul__
interface.Description: Returns the quadratic Hamiltonian scaled by a numeric factor when the scalar is on the left-hand side.

interface.Name: QuadraticHamiltonian.__repr__
interface.Description: Returns a constructor-style representation containing coefficient arrays, constant, and num_modes while preserving the standard NumPy array representation including whitespace, line breaks, and alignment.
